intended_use: German educational Earth learning-journey cards and chapter-header photos for an 8-year-old

assets.title: Storm Clouds over Missouri River
assets.author: U.S. Geological Survey; individual photographer not named on source page
assets.license: Public Domain (U.S. Government work; source explicitly labels image Public Domain)
assets.license_evidence: Source page Sources/Usage: Public Domain. USGS institution is named under Photographer; no individual name provided.
assets.credit_de: Foto: U.S. Geological Survey · Public Domain
assets.factual_subject: Missouri River with wooded banks, sandbar and storm clouds. A real river-and-cloud landscape suitable for introducing water travelling through the landscape.
assets.alt_de: Der Missouri River fließt zwischen grünen Ufern; dunkle Wolken ziehen darüber.
subject_limits: This is a scenic photograph, not a diagram or complete depiction of every stage of the water cycle.
Do not assert that evaporation is visible: visible clouds are not water vapour.

crop_guidance.note: For a wide crop keep the river and its green banks in view; a centred crop can lose most of the water.

assets.title: Rain clouds over mountains
assets.author: U.S. Geological Survey / Southwest Biological Science Center; individual photographer not named on source page
assets.license: Public Domain (source explicitly labels image Public Domain)
assets.credit_de: Foto: U.S. Geological Survey, Southwest Biological Science Center · Public Domain
assets.factual_subject: Rain showers below clouds over a rocky western-U.S. landscape, published by the USGS Southwest Biological Science Center.
assets.alt_de: Unter dunklen Wolken fallen Regenschauer über eine felsige Berglandschaft.
subject_limits: Do not assign a specific cloud subtype or geographic location beyond what the source states.
The published filename contains enhanced; use as the source-published photo, not as an exact measurement of sky colour.

crop_guidance.note: Keep the upper half of the image so the clouds and rain shafts remain recognisable in cards and wide headers.

assets.title: Longs Peak with fall colors
assets.author: National Park Service; individual photographer not named on source page
assets.license: Public Domain (NPS-created image credited NPS Photo without copyright symbol)
assets.license_evidence: The source caption says Longs Peak with fall colors / NPS Photo. NPS Ownership policy says material created by NPS and presented on its website is generally public domain unless otherwise indicated.
assets.credit_de: Foto: National Park Service · Public Domain
assets.factual_subject: Golden autumn vegetation, green conifers, and snow-dusted Longs Peak in Rocky Mountain National Park. The source is a factual NPS page explaining autumn leaf-colour changes.
assets.alt_de: Goldgelbe Herbstpflanzen, grüne Nadelbäume und schneebedeckte Gipfel im Rocky-Mountain-Nationalpark.
subject_limits: One documented autumn scene, not a four-season comparison.
Do not claim that every tree changes colour or loses leaves; green conifers are visible.

crop_guidance.note: Keep the band of golden plants and the distant snowy peak; this works particularly well as a wide learning-journey header.

assets.title: The Moon taken by Apollo 17, AS17-152-23308
assets.author: NASA / Apollo 17 crew
assets.license: Public Domain in the United States (solely created by NASA; verified PD-NASA tag on file description page)
assets.license_evidence: Commons file description explicitly declares public domain because the image was solely created by NASA and links NASA photo ID as17-152-23308. NASA permits factual educational/informational web-page use, with source acknowledgement and no implication of endorsement.
assets.factual_subject: A genuine Apollo 17 photograph of the Moon, NASA Photo ID AS17-152-23308, showing lunar craters, brighter highlands and dark plains against black space.
assets.alt_de: Der Mond vor schwarzem Weltraum mit vielen hellen Kratern und dunklen Ebenen.
subject_limits: This view was photographed from the Apollo spacecraft, so do not describe it as a standard Earth-view Moon-phase photograph.
The file is slightly portrait; use a black frame with object-fit: contain when the whole lunar disc is important.
Do not imply NASA endorses the website.

crop_guidance.note: Use contain on a black background to preserve the whole real lunar disc in landscape headers; use cover only if a close-up crop is intentional.

assets.title: Alpenglow
assets.author: Emily Mesner / National Park Service
assets.license: Public Domain (source explicitly labels image Public Domain; NPS metadata Constraint Public domain, GrantingRights Full)
assets.license_evidence: USGS mirror labels Public Domain and credits National Park Service. NPS API data for AssetID d403e3dc-457a-413d-a967-90693ceab0e7 provides NPS Photo / Emily Mesner, Public domain, Full granting rights.
assets.credit_de: Foto: NPS / Emily Mesner · Public Domain
assets.factual_subject: An Alaska mountain, forest, hill and lake landscape with snowy Mount McKinley / Denali illuminated by reddish alpenglow. The name and height in the NPS source are Mount McKinley and 20,310 feet; the lake is not identified there.
assets.alt_de: Ein verschneites Bergmassiv leuchtet rötlich über einem See und dunklen Waldhängen in Alaska.
subject_limits: Do not guess the lake name or capture time: the source identifies the mountain but does not identify the lake or say sunrise versus sunset.
The USGS URL ends in .png, but the downloaded file is a JPEG; the local extension is corrected without altering its bytes.

crop_guidance.note: Keep the snowy mountain ridge and part of the lake reflection; a wide crop retains both landscape layers.
